description: This file defines different rolling policies for log file management in Apache Spark, including time-based and size-based rolling policies.

classes.name: RollingPolicy
classes.description: Trait defining the interface for log rolling policies, including methods for rollover checks, notifications, and filename generation.

classes.name: TimeBasedRollingPolicy
classes.description: Class implementing a time interval-based log rolling policy.

classes.name: SizeBasedRollingPolicy
classes.description: Class implementing a size threshold-based log rolling policy.

methods.name: shouldRollover
methods.description: Determines if log should rollover based on current conditions.

methods.name: rolledOver
methods.description: Updates internal state after a rollover occurs.

methods.name: bytesWritten
methods.description: Increments the count of bytes written since last rollover.

methods.name: generateRolledOverFileSuffix
methods.description: Generates filename suffix for rolled over files.
